create_policy_for_rl_agent: create a Policy subclass with a custom net to build an RL agent with action distribution and critic head
build_seq2seq_net: build a Seq2SeqNet with RGB and depth encoders plus GPS and compass sensors for navigation
run_policy_act: run the Policy act method to sample actions from observations with optional deterministic mode
evaluate_policy_actions: evaluate actions with Policy evaluate_actions to get value, log probs, and entropy for training
create_seq2seq_model: create a Seq2SeqModel combining Seq2SeqNet with a categorical action distribution for end-to-end navigation
